en.summary: The FY2027 budget plans TT$63.37bn of spending against TT$59.73bn of revenue, cutting the deficit to 2.1% of GDP through measures such as capping loss relief and raising withholding taxes on non-residents. Recovering gas output and developing cross-border Venezuelan gas fields such as Dragon are the key economic variables.
